explanation: An agreement or promise between two parties, in this case between God and the people of Israel, involving obligations and blessings.
God's instructions and commandments given to Moses on Mount Sinai, forming the foundation for the Israelites' faith and practice.
Requirements or responsibilities that one party has toward another; here it refers to the duties of the Israelites according to their covenant with God.
The holy place in Jerusalem where the Israelites worshipped God and performed sacrifices, built by King Solomon.
A gift or act given to God as an expression of gratitude, loyalty, or atonement for sins.
One-tenth of income or harvest given to the temple and priests as a form of support and thanksgiving to God.
Every seventh year when the land was to lie fallow and debts were to be forgiven, part of God's law to ensure justice and rest.
